description: This file defines the WebKit class extending BrowserType, managing WebKit browser instances within the Playwright project. It includes methods for connecting to the browser, environment setup, logging, graceful shutdown, and argument configuration.

classes.name: WebKit
classes.description: Represents the WebKit browser type, providing methods to connect, configure environment, handle logs, close, and generate startup arguments for WebKit browsers.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a WebKit instance with a parent SdkObject.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Connects to a WebKit browser instance via a transport and options, returning a promise resolving to a WKBrowser.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for the WebKit process, particularly setting the cookie jar path on Windows if persistent.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to indicate if the display cannot be opened, wrapping the error message in an ASCII box.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to gracefully close the browser, reusing the transport.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default startup arguments for WebKit based on options, platform, and persistence, including proxy settings.
